screening_rules: Include research using NC data or directly examining NC education; include connected early learning and postsecondary pathways.
Use primary research, author, funder, institutional, or agency sources for included claims.
Keep publication dates separate from data periods and source-check dates.
Use the newer published attendance analyses where located; do not double-count earlier working-paper versions.
Describe abstracts and public project summaries as such; do not imply a full technical review.
Keep undated preliminary summaries undated and cite the known 2022 project-cohort source.
Project descriptions with no reviewed findings are project records and do not count as evidence findings.
Copy exact agenda IDs and wording; distinguish direct question relevance from shared topic vocabulary.
Affiliations are source-reported, not personally confirmed current positions or offers to collaborate.
access_notes: NCLRN pages could not be retrieved by the text web tool. They were read directly in the browser, including project summaries for LETRS, tutoring, coaching, rural workforce, community schools, digital monitoring, and postsecondary enrollment.
The source basis and locator on each included record identify what was read.
Neither the full literature nor every linked report was comprehensively reviewed. Some records are based on author abstracts or institutional summaries.
2022–25 project pages may be stale. The initial catalog does not infer current ongoing status from undated future-tense wording.
